maya: Heads-up: q3b-int3 canary shows an instruction-following drift vs fp16 on the docs->code task. We need a rapid curation pass: isolate prompts that trigger hallucinated imports and tighten the golden. Who's available?
jordi: I can lead prompt triage. Plan: run fingerprint-decode then semantic cluster, pull top 600 suspect prompts into a microgolden. ETA 5pm PT.
aqil: From bench: the drift is concentrated on prompts with multi-file context and explicit imports. Suggest we add targeted scaffolding examples to golden and also label hallucination type (missing-import, wrong-api, hallucinated-class).
labelops: Current pipeline: 900 untagged prompts, 8 contractors live. Per-item times: 70s for short code snippets, 240s for multi-file cases. We can prioritize 400 microgolden items and spin up 2 extra contractors from vendors for the next 12h.
maya: OK prioritize multi-file + imports. Jordi, include a field in the golden records: "failure_mode" and set enum values. Also tag examples with `microgold_q3b_2026-03-23` and push to /shared/curation/qbench/microgold/q3b.
jordi: Will do. I'll run `python tools/fingerprint.py --mode decode --sample 1000 --out suspects.ndjson` then `embed-search --sim 0.9 --topk 5` to get paraphrase clusters.
aqil: For eval gating: propose local check `devbench/compare.py --candidate q3b-int3 --baseline q3b-fp16 --prompts microgold_q3b_2026-03-23 --metrics exact_import_accuracy,api_mismatch_rate` and require api_mismatch_rate <= baseline + 0.02 to pass canary.
labelops: Confirm vendor slots: inbound contractors will be live at 16:30 PT, can accept batch 1 (200 items). SLA for batch 1: 6h.
jordi: Note: some prompts have multiple ground-truth files; label UI needs the attachment view. @labelops can you enable multi-file mode for that batch?
labelops: Enabled `multi_file=true` for batch 1 and flagged UI tickets. Also adding quick annotation guide: labelers mark which import line was hallucinated and paste the expected import.
maya: Good. Also, QA: include 50 adversarial synth prompts (created by `tools/synth_halluc.py --mode imports --n 50`) to stress the microgold.
devbench: Auto-run scheduled: nightly smoke will include microgold. I'll kick off an ad-hoc compare after first labeled batch. Command: `./ci/run_compare.sh q3b-int3 q3b-fp16 microgold_q3b_2026-03-23`
curation-bot: Auto-note: microgold created by jordi at /shared/curation/qbench/microgold/q3b/microgold_q3b_2026-03-23.json (size 352).
jordi: Filing a short README in that dir: selection heuristics, labelling taxonomy, and a snippet for reproducing failures locally. Will call out to avoid prompts requiring >1.5k tokens of reference output.
aqil: Also track a lightweight metric: `halluc_import_rate` and add alert if >0.05 during canary traffic. If alert fires, auto-fallback to q3b-fp16 for that route.
maya: Sounds good. After the bench we will reconvene and decide whether to widen canary or pause. Thanks team. :white_check_mark:
